entries.title: Genesis 24:1
segments: ¶Now Abraham was old, well advanced in age; and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

entries.title: Genesis 24:2
segments: So Abraham said to the oldest servant of his house, who ruled over all that he had, "Please, put your hand under my thigh,

entries.title: Genesis 24:3
segments: "and I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell;

entries.title: Genesis 24:4
segments: "but you shall go to my country and to my family, and take a wife for my son Isaac."

entries.title: Genesis 24:5
segments: And the servant said to him, "Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land. Must I take your son back to the land from which you came?"

entries.title: Genesis 24:6
segments: But Abraham said to him, "Beware that you do not take my son back there.

entries.title: Genesis 24:7
segments: "The LORD God of heaven, who took me from my father's house and from the land of my family, and who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, 'To your descendants I give this land,' He will send His angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

entries.title: Genesis 24:8
segments: "And if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you will be released from this oath; only do not take my son back there."

entries.title: Genesis 24:9
segments: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

entries.title: Genesis 24:10
segments: ¶Then the servant took ten of his master's camels and departed, for all his master's goods [were in] his hand. And he arose and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

entries.title: Genesis 24:11
segments: And he made his camels kneel down outside the city by a well of water at evening time, the time when women go out to draw [water].

entries.title: Genesis 24:12
segments: Then he said, "O LORD God of my master Abraham, please give me success this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

entries.title: Genesis 24:13
segments: "Behold, [here] I stand by the well of water, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

entries.title: Genesis 24:14
segments: "Now let it be that the young woman to whom I say, 'Please let down your pitcher that I may drink,' and she says, 'Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink' -[let] her [be the one] You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. And by this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master."

entries.title: Genesis 24:15
segments: And it happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, came out with her pitcher on her shoulder.

entries.title: Genesis 24:16
segments: Now the young woman [was] very beautiful to behold, a virgin; no man had known her. And she went down to the well, filled her pitcher, and came up.

entries.title: Genesis 24:17
segments: And the servant ran to meet her and said, "Please let me drink a little water from your pitcher."

entries.title: Genesis 24:18
segments: So she said, "Drink, my lord." Then she quickly let her pitcher down to her hand, and gave him a drink.

entries.title: Genesis 24:19
segments: And when she had finished giving him a drink, she said, "I will draw [water] for your camels also, until they have finished drinking."

entries.title: Genesis 24:20
segments: Then she quickly emptied her pitcher into the trough, ran back to the well to draw [water], and drew for all his camels.

entries.title: Genesis 24:21
segments: And the man, wondering at her, remained silent so as to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

entries.title: Genesis 24:22
segments: So it was, when the camels had finished drinking, that the man took a golden nose ring weighing half a shekel, and two bracelets for her wrists weighing ten [shekels] of gold,

entries.title: Genesis 24:23
segments: and said, "Whose daughter [are] you? Tell me, please, is there room [in] your father's house for us to lodge?"

entries.title: Genesis 24:24
segments: So she said to him, "I [am] the daughter of Bethuel, Milcah's son, whom she bore to Nahor."

entries.title: Genesis 24:25
segments: Moreover she said to him, "We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge."

entries.title: Genesis 24:26
segments: Then the man bowed down his head and worshiped the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 24:27
segments: And he said, "Blessed [be] the LORD God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken His mercy and His truth toward my master. As for me, being on the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren."

entries.title: Genesis 24:28
segments: So the young woman ran and told her mother's household these things.

entries.title: Genesis 24:29
segments: ¶Now Rebekah had a brother whose name [was] Laban, and Laban ran out to the man by the well.

entries.title: Genesis 24:30
segments: So it came to pass, when he saw the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister's wrists, and when he heard the words of his sister Rebekah, saying, "Thus the man spoke to me," that he went to the man. And there he stood by the camels at the well.

entries.title: Genesis 24:31
segments: And he said, "Come in, O blessed of the LORD! Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels."

entries.title: Genesis 24:32
segments: Then the man came to the house. And he unloaded the camels, and provided straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who [were] with him.

entries.title: Genesis 24:33
segments: [Food] was set before him to eat, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told about my errand." And he said, "Speak on."

entries.title: Genesis 24:34
segments: So he said, "I [am] Abraham's servant.

entries.title: Genesis 24:35
segments: "The LORD has blessed my master greatly, and he has become great; and He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

entries.title: Genesis 24:36
segments: "And Sarah my master's wife bore a son to my master when she was old; and to him he has given all that he has.

entries.title: Genesis 24:37
segments: "Now my master made me swear, saying, 'You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell;

entries.title: Genesis 24:38
segments: 'but you shall go to my father's house and to my family, and take a wife for my son.'

entries.title: Genesis 24:39
segments: "And I said to my master, 'Perhaps the woman will not follow me.'

entries.title: Genesis 24:40
segments: "But he said to me, 'The LORD, before whom I walk, will send His angel with you and prosper your way; and you shall take a wife for my son from my family and from my father's house.

entries.title: Genesis 24:41
segments: 'You will be clear from this oath when you arrive among my family; for if they will not give [her] to you, then you will be released from my oath.'

entries.title: Genesis 24:42
segments: "And this day I came to the well and said, 'O LORD God of my master Abraham, if You will now prosper the way in which I go,

entries.title: Genesis 24:43
segments: 'behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass that when the virgin comes out to draw [water], and I say to her, "Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,"

entries.title: Genesis 24:44
segments: 'and she says to me, "Drink, and I will draw for your camels also," -[let] her [be] the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master's son.'

entries.title: Genesis 24:45
segments: "But before I had finished speaking in my heart, there was Rebekah, coming out with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down to the well and drew [water]. And I said to her, 'Please let me drink.'

entries.title: Genesis 24:46
segments: "And she made haste and let her pitcher down from her [shoulder], and said, 'Drink, and I will give your camels a drink also.' So I drank, and she gave the camels a drink also.

entries.title: Genesis 24:47
segments: "Then I asked her, and said, 'Whose daughter [are] you?' And she said, 'The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bore to him.' So I put the nose ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.

entries.title: Genesis 24:48
segments: "And I bowed my head and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the way of truth to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.

entries.title: Genesis 24:49
segments: "Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. And if not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand or to the left."

entries.title: Genesis 24:50
segments: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, "The thing comes from the LORD; we cannot speak to you either bad or good.

entries.title: Genesis 24:51
segments: "Here [is] Rebekah before you; take [her] and go, and let her be your master's son's wife, as the LORD has spoken."

entries.title: Genesis 24:52
segments: And it came to pass, when Abraham's servant heard their words, that he worshiped the LORD, [bowing himself] to the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 24:53
segments: Then the servant brought out jewelry of silver, jewelry of gold, and clothing, and gave [them] to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and to her mother.

entries.title: Genesis 24:54
segments: ¶And he and the men who [were] with him ate and drank and stayed all night. Then they arose in the morning, and he said, "Send me away to my master."

entries.title: Genesis 24:55
segments: But her brother and her mother said, "Let the young woman stay with us [a few] days, at least ten; after that she may go."

entries.title: Genesis 24:56
segments: And he said to them, "Do not hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way; send me away so that I may go to my master."

entries.title: Genesis 24:57
segments: So they said, "We will call the young woman and ask her personally."

entries.title: Genesis 24:58
segments: Then they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" And she said, "I will go."

entries.title: Genesis 24:59
segments: So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her nurse, and Abraham's servant and his men.

entries.title: Genesis 24:60
segments: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her: "Our sister, [may] you [become The mother of] thousands of ten thousands; And may your descendants possess The gates of those who hate them."

entries.title: Genesis 24:61
segments: Then Rebekah and her maids arose, and they rode on the camels and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and departed.

entries.title: Genesis 24:62
segments: ¶Now Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he dwelt in the South.

entries.title: Genesis 24:63
segments: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field in the evening; and he lifted his eyes and looked, and there, the camels [were] coming.

entries.title: Genesis 24:64
segments: Then Rebekah lifted her eyes, and when she saw Isaac she dismounted from her camel;

entries.title: Genesis 24:65
segments: for she had said to the servant, "Who [is] this man walking in the field to meet us?" The servant said, "It [is] my master." So she took a veil and covered herself.

entries.title: Genesis 24:66
segments: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

entries.title: Genesis 24:67
segments: Then Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent; and he took Rebekah and she became his wife, and he loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother's [death].
